claim: For an ordinary smooth genus-two curve \(X\) over an algebraically closed field \(k\) of characteristic \(2\), the scheme-theoretic base locus of the Frobenius-pullback (Verschiebung) map \(V:\mathcal M_{X_1}\dashrightarrow\mathcal M_X\) on moduli spaces of semistable rank-two bundles with trivial determinant is supported at \((1:1:1:1)\) in theta coordinates and has local ring \(k[a,b]/(a^2,b^2)\); in particular, it is a length-\(4\) local complete intersection with Hilbert function \((1,2,1)\).

scientific_limitations_integrity.integrity: The coordinate ideal and local ring are stated explicitly; independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations_integrity.limitations: Does not cover nonordinary curves, other genera, or odd characteristic. The local algebra is proved by explicit reduction; a related 2006 article was accessible only through its abstract.
scientific_limitations_integrity.scope: Ordinary smooth genus-two curves over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two; the scheme is defined by the four theta-coordinate quadrics of the Frobenius-pullback map.

title: Scheme-theoretic base locus of the genus-two Verschiebung in characteristic two
